alt: 雨雲來臨，眾人收拾野餐用品，一人卻仍在草地鋪開毯子。
scene_prompt: On a picnic lawn as dark rain clouds arrive and the first drops fall, everyone quickly folds blankets and carries baskets toward a nearby shelter. One oblivious adult stubbornly starts setting out a large picnic blanket in the exposed grass, ignoring a companion pointing at the approaching rain. Show failure to understand the immediate situation, no clocks or text.
